identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no continuity or authority claim.

observed_failures.observed: The first combined branch, head, upstream, status, and baton-existence wrapper completed without attributable output.
observed_failures.recovery: Split immutable head, live equality, tracked state, untracked state, and baton probes into bounded scalar calls.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not bind slow Git status and network-independent source claims to one short wrapper.

observed_failures.observed: The first baton metadata probe rendered its UTF-8 heading with a mojibake em dash.
observed_failures.recovery: Read the baton explicitly as UTF-8 in bounded ordered chunks and verify its exact Git blob.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Declare text encoding for every induction, baton, and lifecycle read.

observed_failures.observed: A 300-line middle baton chunk exceeded the useful output budget and hid part of the ordered proposal text.
observed_failures.recovery: Reread only the affected range as two 150-line UTF-8 chunks.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Size long document reads by byte and token budget before dispatch.

observed_failures.observed: The first recursive SKILL.md filename filter produced no attributable matches despite installed family controls.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate only the top-level skill directories, select exact names, and then read each required SKILL.md and reference directly.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Treat an empty discovery pipeline as zero-credit until exact known paths are checked.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only reference metadata probe used a direct foreach-to-pipeline form that PowerShell rejected before execution.
observed_failures.recovery: Materialize foreach output into a bounded array before piping it to JSON serialization.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize compound PowerShell iteration results before downstream pipelines.

observed_failures.observed: The first cross-manifest exclusion parser assumed every exclusion was an object with a path field; four x1 string exclusions generated null-key diagnostics.
observed_failures.recovery: Inspect exclusion shapes and normalize string and object forms separately without replaying successful blob comparisons.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect JSON key and value shapes before generic traversal.

observed_failures.observed: The first isolated x1 exclusion check treated phase-relative paths as repository-relative and falsely reported four missing files.
observed_failures.recovery: Prefix x1 lifecycle exclusions with the declared phase root, then verify the normalized tree paths.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Bind every path comparison to its declared path domain.

observed_failures.observed: Horology, garment or costume, observatory, planetarium, bookbinding, darkroom, and seed-bank practice candidates collided with inherited proposal families and received no novelty credit.
observed_failures.recovery: Select the aquarium life-support and animal-observation lens, then run every title against all 2,530 frozen rows at the unchanged threshold.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Perform domain and lexical neighbor screening before writing proposal dossiers.

observed_failures.observed: A direct read-only open of the CITES appendices page returned an internal tool error and no source evidence.
observed_failures.recovery: Do not rely on the failed page; keep trade legality exact-gated and use only successfully resolved official sources.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: A failed source open never becomes citation or current-status credit.

observed_failures.observed: A direct read-only open of the guessed AZA standards URL returned an internal tool error and no source evidence.
observed_failures.recovery: Resolve the official AZA accreditation materials and animal-care manual pages through bounded official-domain search.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Verify official document locations through a successful current page before recording status.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed workflow-plan.schema.json, which is not an installed reference and produced no schema evidence.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate the exact skill directory and read workflow-plan-schema.md before constructing the request.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve installed reference filenames before reading them.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only mojibake scan used a double-quoted Unicode alternation that PowerShell rejected before execution.
observed_failures.recovery: Repeat the bounded scan with a single-quoted literal pattern.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use single-quoted literal patterns for Unicode regex probes in PowerShell.

observed_failures.observed: The first large workflow rewrite hunk did not apply because the console-rendered Unicode context did not byte-match the UTF-8 source.
observed_failures.recovery: Use exact ASCII function markers, retain the inherited block as noncalled compatibility text, and add the current implementation at a stable boundary.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep semantic patch contexts short and ASCII-stable when inherited text contains non-ASCII characters.

observed_failures.observed: A later mixed cleanup hunk was rejected at the inherited index heading even though its ASCII subchanges were valid.
observed_failures.recovery: Apply ASCII-only semantic hunks separately and audit the remaining Unicode line by code point.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not combine independent ASCII edits with a Unicode-sensitive context line.

observed_failures.observed: A one-line heading patch still failed because the patch channel rendered the em dash differently from the UTF-8 source context.
observed_failures.recovery: Retain the generated-content correction in the current overview and remove the unused legacy block with an ASCII marker-bounded cleanup.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Avoid depending on a non-ASCII glyph as the sole patch anchor.

observed_failures.observed: The first x1 builder run expected an effective_count key in Sable's preregistration gap register and stopped before proposal artifacts were written.
observed_failures.recovery: Read Sable's realized x2 gap and exact-gate registers, which carry the sealed effective counts of 108 and 107.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Select inherited truth registers by lifecycle state and inspect their keys before scalar comparison.

observed_failures.observed: The first 2,530-row novelty audit rejected proposal 27 at Jaccard 0.7083 against Sable's purpose-scoped organ-record permit.
observed_failures.recovery: Replace the inherited permit pattern with an observation-batch provenance capsule and rerun the unchanged 0.60 audit.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not reuse a predecessor's purpose, audience, scope, expiry, and nonauthorization mechanism bundle.

observed_failures.observed: A bounded proposal-title diagnostic encountered an unencodable Māori character under the default CP1252 console after printing earlier rows.
observed_failures.recovery: Use UTF-8 output or ASCII-safe JSON diagnostics and do not treat the partial listing as complete.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Set UTF-8 explicitly before emitting proposal text that may contain Māori orthography.
